title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：relief　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 relief 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the counsellor ① brought the relief that no listener in the garden would have described, and he said the bringing was the whole of the evening. The ② relief, meaning the help itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed undescribed in the book; relief, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ bit of relief in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ relief at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Relief, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the counsellor said the describing is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the relief was the whole of the matter, meaning the comfort and not the help. The ⑥ relief, meaning the comfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; relief, he said, is either something you bring or the only word that means both help and a comfort. He said the comfort is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ relief had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ relief of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of describing; relief, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ relief I remember is the relief described in the journal, which closed in 1968 and is still described as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Relief, my mother said in 1970, is the only thing that improves by being described; all relief, she said, is a comfort that has agreed to look like help. She said the comfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 缓解；救济（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 缓解；救济（指那份缓解本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：bring the relief 带来这一份缓解
D. n. 缓解；救济（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 缓解之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的缓解之事）
F. n. 缓解；救济（指心记里写到、被描述的那一份）
G. n. 缓解、宽慰（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 宽慰（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: brought the relief that no listener in the garden would have described
The relief, meaning the help itself and not the letter
Every bit of relief in that garden
the relief at the far bench
the relief was the whole of the matter
the relief had become a line in a journal
The relief of the whole thing

answers.why: bring the relief 意为“带来这一份缓解”，1961 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯描述的一份缓解做了一遍。
relief 意为“缓解；救济”，指那份缓解本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被描述。
relief 意为“缓解；救济”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
relief 意为“缓解；救济”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
relief 意为“缓解、宽慰”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份宽慰就是那件事的全部。
relief 意为“宽慰”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份缓解，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
relief 意为“缓解；救济”，指心记里写到、被描述的那一份，到 1966 年这一份成了心记里的一行。
relief 意为“缓解之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的缓解之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的描述。
relief 意为“缓解；救济”，我记得的是心记里描述过的那一份，1968 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一份。
relief 为抽象总称，母亲 1970 年说，缓解是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的缓解。

items: 1961 年那位谈心人带来了小园里没有一位倾听者肯描述的一份缓解，他说这一遍才是那个黄昏的全部。（bring the relief）
那份缓解，指的是那份缓解本身而不是薄薄的信，经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被描述。（relief）
那处小园里每一分缓解旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。（relief）
最远那张长椅那份缓解，指的是他们留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（relief）
叔叔说这份宽慰就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那份缓解。（relief）
